adversarialReviewOfTheWorkSoFar.state: ONE FOUND AND FIXED, RECORDED HERE
adversarialReviewOfTheWorkSoFar.detail: The first reconnaissance scan issued `SET statement_timeout` as its OWN psql -c, which is a separate transaction, so the timeout never applied to the query it was meant to bound — every scan ran unbounded. Caught while writing the runner; the runner now sets it as a CONNECTION STARTUP parameter. Also: the first version of that scan had an invalid GROUP BY and failed 25 of 25 queries while the script still printed WRITTEN SCAN DONE. The script now fails loudly on any non-zero rc. Both are the same defect class this programme hunts: a control that cannot fail is not a control.
